tasks.label: Infra: Create Network (Safe)
tasks.command: docker network inspect infra-storage >/dev/null 2>&1 || docker network create infra-storage
tasks.detail: Checks if infra-storage exists; creates it only if missing.

tasks.label: Infra: Delete Network
tasks.detail: Forcefully removes the shared infra-storage network.

tasks.label: Infra: Total Reset (Compose Down + Cleanup)
tasks.command: docker compose down --remove-orphans && docker container prune -f && docker image prune -f && docker builder prune -af
tasks.detail: Stops infra, removes orphaned containers and dangling images. Leaves network intact.
